items.label: Complete Set
items.value: The product includes four 33.8-inch (approx. 86 cm) tall rust-proof metal plant trellis, designed to support tall climbing plants as they thrive. Each trelli can be easily disassembled into two smaller 16.9-inch (approx. 50 cm) tall stands suitable for smaller plants to meet your multiple potted. simply use the same trellis for different growing periods of different potted plants

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: Our durable flower trellis crafted from 3.7mm thick solid metal rods, they resist bending or breaking. The surface is coated with a rust-resistant finish that prevents corrosion, ensuring long-lasting use for both indoor and outdoor settings

items.label: Easy to Install and Maintain Trellis
items.value: 10 second quick installation, no tools required.Each trellis features two pieces that design allows for free combination and use, connect the top and bottom, and insert into the soil. Catering to different plant-growing needs. Easily expand or resize the plant trellis as your plants mature, ensuring the perfect fit for every stage of their development.Even novice gardening enthusiasts can easily get started

items.label: Perfect Plant Support
items.value: Crafted to perfection, our plant trellis offer optimal support for vining plants, allowing them to gracefully ascend and thrive in the air. Its elegant scrolling design adds a touch of French garden charm to any space. Works beautifully as a decorative frame for flowering vines (like roses hoyas, honeysuckle and wisteria) and as a sturdy support for edibles (like peas and beans)

items.label: Great Plant Gift
items.value: An ideal gift for plant lovers, helping them cultivate and showcase their beloved plants while adding greenery and vibrancy to their homes
